summary: The PR simplifies the PostgreSQL client code by using subprocess.run and setting PGPASSWORD in the environment, which is a good improvement. However, there are some minor issues related to signal handling and test coverage.

issues.description: The signal handling logic is moved outside the try block, which might not be the intended behavior. The original code restores the SIGINT handler in the finally block to ensure it is always restored, even if an exception occurs.

While the tests pass, there is no specific test case added to verify the new behavior of setting PGPASSWORD via the environment variable. Additional tests should be added to ensure this change works as expected.
